title: blanks
summary: Return a character row vector of spaces.

gpu_support.notes: The public API has no interactive GPU-array overload. RunMat can gather a resident scalar length only when RunMat extensions are enabled.

fusion.notes: Not eligible for fusion; this builtin materializes host text or logical results.

description: `blanks(n)` returns a 1-by-n character row containing space characters. The length accepts integer-valued single, double, or any of the eight built-in integer classes.
behaviors: Returns a 1-by-n character row of spaces.
Length n accepts integer-valued single, double, int8, int16, int32, int64, uint8, uint16, uint32, or uint64.
A zero or negative length returns a 1-by-0 character array.
Interactive GPU-resident length input is available only as an explicitly gated RunMat extension.
examples: blanks(3) returns a 1-by-3 character row of spaces.

faqs.question: Does an integer length produce an integer array?
faqs.answer: No. The integer is a structural length control; the output is always a character row.
